- 30% of 1000 went through exit A: $ 1000 \times 0.30 = 300 $  
- Remaining students after exit A: $ 1000 - 300 = 700 $  
- 3/5 of the remaining went through exit B: $ 700 \times \frac{3}{5} = 420 $  
- Remaining students after exit B: $ 700 - 420 = 280 $  
- These remaining students went through exit C: 280
